$comment: Frozen payload for the `fixture_demo` source. NOT a capture from any real landlord — every value is invented, and it is shaped to exercise the pipeline's known traps rather than to look realistic. A real captured payload replaces this per source, under tests/fixtures/rent/<source>/, scrubbed before committing.

$traps.item-2: an excluded tenure (PLAI) stated in a structured field — must REJECT, never notify
$traps.item-3: a mixed-source listing with no tenure signal at all — must DIGEST, never match (fail-closed). Also the only item using the ALTERNATE payload shape (address.city, price, nbRooms), so the field map's fallback candidates are genuinely exercised rather than merely declared
$traps.item-4: rooms and surface absent — must NOT be disqualified (hard rule 9: null is not zero)
$traps.item-5: rent reported hors charges with charges alongside — CC must be DERIVED as 1480, which passes the 1800 ceiling
$traps.item-6: hasElevator false with a high floor — a score penalty, never a rejection
$traps.item-7: a parking space, no rooms and no surface — the size filters cannot catch it, so the title exclusion must
$traps.item-8: a French-formatted rent string and a relative URL — number parsing and base_url resolution
$traps.item-9: wrong commune — must be disqualified on location
$traps.item-10: commune absent but postcode present — judged on the postcode alone (Q32)
